solutions.title: Recursive slicing
solutions.strategy: Split traversal arrays for each subtree directly.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each recursive step can copy or scan arrays, and skewed trees repeat that work across many levels.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Copied traversal slices can accumulate across recursive calls in skewed inputs.

solutions.title: Index map ranges
solutions.strategy: Use inorder positions and traversal index ranges to build each subtree without copying.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is created once and each inorder lookup is constant time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The index map and recursion stack store O(n) state.
